sources: recreation.gov public campsite search API for facility 232772 (12 sites)

values.note: $20/night per single site including 1 vehicle; additional vehicle $10/night (paid to the host on arrival, not in advance); campground day use $6. The FS page also carries an older '$18.00 / $9' line; recreation.gov's 2026 rate table and the page's own 'Overnight Use' block both give $20.

fees.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/limber-pine-campground ('Single Site: $20 per night (includes 1 driving vehicle) Additional Vehicle Fee: $10 per additional vehicle Campground Day Use (over an hour): $6 per day'; page last updated April 30, 2026) + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232772/rates (Peak Season 2026-05-22 to 2026-09-10 STANDARD NONELECTRIC $20; walk-in season 2026-09-11 to 09-30 $20), read 2026-10-22

discounts.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/limber-pine-campground ('1/2 price fees with Interagency Senior or Access Pass'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: '5/26 - 9/8 Weather Dependent. Fees Charged May - September, Weather Dependent.' recreation.gov's 2026 rate seasons run wider (reservable May 22 - Sept 10, first-come walk-in Sept 11-30); 'Opening and closing dates are weather permitting.'

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/limber-pine-campground (Seasons of Use '5/26 - 9/8 Weather Dependent.') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232772 (notice 'Opening and closing dates are weather permitting') and /rates, read 2026-10-22

values.note: Run by concessionaire Recreation Resource Management of America (RRMA). Most sites book on recreation.gov; 2 sites (1 standard, 1 tent) are not reservable, and recreation.gov sells a first-come walk-in season after the reservable one. 'FIRST COME FIRST SERVE sites must be booked in person.' Extra vehicles are paid to the host on arrival.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232772 (notices 'FIRST COME FIRST SERVE sites must be booked in person'; rules maxConsecutiveStay 16) + recreation.gov site search for facility 232772 (10 reservable / 2 non-reservable) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/limber-pine-campground ('There is a 16 day maximum stay on all Beartooth Ranger District campgrounds'; Contact Name 'Recreation Resource Management of America (RRMA)'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 13 sites, max trailer length 60 ft. recreation.gov catalogs 12 (9 standard, 3 tent-only); standard-site lengths run 22-60 ft, most 55 ft.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/limber-pine-campground ('Camp sites: 13'; Parking 'Max Trailer Length : 60ft') + recreation.gov site search for facility 232772 (max vehicle lengths 22, 35, 45, 50, 55 x4, 60), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Accessible vault toilets, hand-pumped drinking water, food storage lockers. No trash service here: use the receptacles at Greenough Lake Campground. Host at Parkside CG sells firewood ($7/bundle).

facilities.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232772 ('Accessible vault toilets and hand-pumped drinking water are provided. Trash can be deposited in receptacles at the Greenough Lake Campground'; amenities 'Food Storage Locker') + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/custergallatin/recreation/limber-pine-campground ('Host : Yes at Parkside CG'; 'Firewood: $7.00 / bundle'; 'Potable water is available at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

note: Custer Gallatin NF (Beartooth Ranger District), ~11 mi S of Red Lodge on US-212 then 0.9 mi W on Main Fork Rd (FR 2421), near the base of the Beartooth Highway switchbacks. On the banks of the Main Fork of Rock Creek in aspen and pine; Greenough Lake 0.5 mi away. Grizzly country: food storage rules apply. --Claude
summary: FS page (updated April 30, 2026) + rec.gov: confirmed $20 base, 13 sites, 60-ft max trailer, vault toilets, potable water, reservable on recreation.gov. Added $10 extra vehicle, Senior/Access half price, recreation.gov platform, some FCFS sites, 16-night max, operator RRMA. Changed season closes 09-10 -> opens 05-26 / closes 09-08 (FS Seasons of Use). Hookups (derived none) left. The Glacier Lake Road #2421 winter closure order starts at the Hellroaring Road junction, beyond the campground. Note trimmed of restated sites, hookups, facilities, length and booking.
